protocol.name: starry_system_v1

description.summary: system shell interface between starry-compositor and starry-springboard

protocol.description:
The compositor owns outputs, input and application windows. The system shell (springboard) draws the home screen, status bar and other system UI on its own surfaces and drives application scenes through this protocol, in the way SpringBoard hosts application scenes through FrontBoard on iOS.
The global is only advertised to the springboard process started by the compositor itself.

entry.summary: the surface already has a role

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: give a surface a system layer role

request.description: The surface is shown on the given layer at position (0, 0) of the output, in logical coordinates, once it has a buffer. Areas outside the surface's input region pass touches to whatever lies below.
